description: Ask a public RFC 3161 Time-Stamp Authority to sign the agent's current state. The one fact here the operator cannot manufacture: a timestamp cannot be issued for a time that has passed. An unchanged state returns the anchor it already has. Costs 100 units. Authenticate with the workspace key in _meta[satledger/api-key].

api_key.description: Your workspace key, if your client cannot set _meta[satledger/api-key]. Prefer _meta: arguments are logged by most clients.

name: anchor_agent
title: Anchor the agent's state
